board: DFRobot Gravity: Digital Crash Sensor (SEN0138-L, left lever; SEN0138-R is the mirror-image right-lever version)
reason: Modelled from DFRobot's v1.0 schematic (micro switch to GND, 10 kOhm pull-up to VCC on D, LED+1 kOhm VCC-to-D) as an active-low digital-sensor with boardPullUp 10000, powered at 3.3 V on 3.3 V boards; check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://wiki.dfrobot.com/sen0138-l/ (Pinout table: 1 D digital output, 2 VCC, 3 GND; matches schematic J1)
